'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[2025 Gaza City offensive]]
****The [[Israeli Defense Forces]] issues an [[Gaza Strip evacuations|evacuation order]] for the entirety of [[Gaza City]] amidst its renewed offensive. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/09/09/middleeast/israel-gaza-city-evacuation-netanyahu-warning-intl (CNN)]
**[[Israeli airstrike on Hamas leadership in Qatar]]
***The [[Israeli Air Force]] carries out a series of [[airstrike]]s against the [[Hamas]] leadership's office in [[Doha]], [[Qatar]], during a meeting. Six people are killed; however, the entire leadership survived according to [[Palestine|Palestinian]] and Hamas sources. A member of the Qatari security forces is among the fatalities. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/9/live-israel-pounds-gaza-city-as-netanyahu-tells-residents-to-leave-now (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c78m71vl91vt (BBC News)] [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/gulf/2025/09/09/several-blasts-heard-in-qatar-s-doha-reuters-witnesses-say (Al Arabiya)]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***The [[Houthis]] launch a [[ballistic missile]] at [[Israel]], which is intercepted. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-intercepts-houthi-missile/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.ynet.co.il/news/article/rkfcc0p5lg (YNet)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***A [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] airstrike kills at least 24 people collecting their [[pension]]s in [[Yarova]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-airstrike-ukrainian-village-kills-over-20-zelenskiy-says-2025-09-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Nepalese Gen Z protests]]
**[[Nepal]]ese [[Prime Minister of Nepal|prime minister]] [[K.P. Sharma Oli]] resigns in response to the protests amid a [[government of Nepal|government]] collapse. [https://news24online.com/world/nepal-president-ram-chandra-poudel-resigns-amid-ongoing-protests/629416 (News24)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/nepal-pm-oli-quits-anti-corruption-protests-spiral-his-aide-says-2025-09-09 (Reuters)]
**The [[Federal Parliament of Nepal|Federal Parliament]] building is stormed and set on fire by protesters. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/9/nepal-protests-live-nepali-congress-office-top-leaders-homes-set-on-fire (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Nepal)|Foreign minister]] [[Arzu Rana Deuba]] and her husband, former prime minister [[Sher Bahadur Deuba]], are assaulted at their residence. [https://en.himalpress.com/nc-president-deuba-wife-arzu-attacked/ (''Himalpress'')]
**A video shows [[Ministry of Finance (Nepal)|finance minister]] [[Bishnu Prasad Paudel]] being beaten and dragged through the streets of [[Kathmandu]] by protesters. His condition is unknown. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/video-nepal-finance-minister-chased-through-street-kicked-attacked-9243749 (NDTV)]
**The private residence of [[President of Nepal|President]] [[Ram Chandra Poudel]] is stormed and vandalized by protesters while the headquarters of the [[Communist Party of Nepal (Unified Marxist–Leninist)|Communist Party of Nepal (UML)]] and the [[Nepali Congress]] party are both destroyed. [https://www.israelhayom.com/2025/09/09/nepali-pms-home-set-ablaze-as-rioters-force-resignation/ (''Israel Hayom'')]
**[[Nakhu Jail]] in [[Lalitpur District, Nepal|Lalitpur District]], [[Bagmati Province]], is stormed by protesters and all [[Prisoner|inmate]]s are freed, including prominent opposition figure [[Rabi Lamichhane]]. The prison is then set ablaze. [https://www.setopati.com/politics/368902 (Setopati)]
**Kathmandu's [[Tribhuvan International Airport]] is closed and occupied by the [[Nepali Army]], while several airlines suspend flights to Nepal due to the ongoing [[Civil disorder|civil unrest]]. [https://www.onlinekhabar.com/2025/09/1760962/genji-arrives-at-airport-gate-large-number-of-troops-mobilized (Online Khabar)] [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/nri/latest-updates/nepal-protests-tribhuvan-international-airport-in-kathmandu-cancels-all-domestic-and-international-flights/articleshow/123781926.cms?from=mdr (''The Economic Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Seven members of a single family are killed in the detonation of explosives stockpiled inside a house in [[Bala Buluk District]], [[Farah Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://amu.tv/198193/ (Amu TV)]
*[[World War II bomb disposal in Europe]]
**[[Police Corps (Slovakia)|Police]] in [[Bratislava]], [[Slovakia]], evacuate several downtown blocks and suspend traffic and [[Transport in Slovakia|public transport]] after the discovery of a 500-pound (225-kilogram) [[Slovakia during World War II|World War II]] [[unexploded bomb]] in a construction site. [https://apnews.com/article/slovakia-bratislava-evacuation-wwii-bomb-2a41945149ce722ca1dbbbf03728bd96 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[UNICEF]] reports that for the first time, [[Childhood obesity|obesity]] has surpassed [[Undernutrition in children|undernourishment]] as the leading form of [[Epidemiology of malnutrition|global malnutrition]] among children and adolescents. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250910-obese-surpass-undernourished-youths-for-first-time-un-warns (AFP via France 24)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Cambodia–United States relations]], [[Myanmar–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] announces more [[United States government sanctions|sanctions]] on [[internet fraud|cyber scamming]] rings operating in [[Cambodia]] and [[Myanmar]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/society-equity/us-sanctions-billion-dollar-cyber-scam-networks-myanmar-cambodia-2025-09-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Iraq–Israel relations]], [[Iraq–United States relations]]
**[[Shia Islam in Iraq|Iraqi Shia]] militia [[Kata'ib Hezbollah]] releases [[Russians|Russian]]–[[Israelis|Israeli]] researcher [[Elizabeth Tsurkov]] who was [[Foreign hostages in Iraq|abducted]] in 2023 during a research trip to [[Iraq]] following negotiations involving Israel and the United States. [https://www.cnbc.com/2025/09/09/princeton-researcher-tsurkov-released-from-militia-captivity-in-iraq.html (CNBC)]
*[[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**[[Iran]] and the [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] agree to resume [[Nuclear facilities in Iran|nuclear site]] inspections which were suspended after U.S. and Israeli strikes, with Iran warning the deal will be void if [[international sanctions against Iran|international sanctions]] are reimposed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-iaea-announce-agreement-resuming-nuclear-inspections-2025-09-09/ (Reuters)]
*Former German minister of foreign affairs [[Annalena Baerbock]] is elected and sworn in as the new [[president of the United Nations General Assembly]]. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/stephaniefillion/2025/09/09/ex-german-foreign-minister-becomes-80th-un-general-assembly-president/ (''Forbes'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Ecuadorian conflict (2024–present)|Ecuadorian conflict]]
**[[National Police of Ecuador|Ecuadorian police]] seize more than [[United States dollar|US$]]313 million in [[real estate]] assets from the armed group [[:es:Comandos de la Frontera|Comandos de la Frontera]], which [[Government of Ecuador|the government]] links to [[War on drugs in Ecuador|drug-related]] [[Crime in Ecuador|organized crime]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ecuador-seizes-over-300-million-properties-armed-group-2025-09-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[LGBTQ rights in Hong Kong]]
**The [[Hong Kong]] [[Court of First Instance (Hong Kong)|Court of First Instance]] rules that a [[Same-sex relationship|lesbian couple]] are both legal parents of their son born through [[reciprocal in vitro fertilization]], marking a [[landmark case]] in [[Same-sex parenting|parental recognition for same-sex couples]] in Hong Kong. [https://apnews.com/article/hong-kong-lesbian-couple-parent-right-child-870fc0b2dad4889f553a857c9495e22a (AP)]
*An [[arson]] attack on two [[power pole]]s in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]], causes a widespread blackout affecting the [[Berlin S-Bahn]], emergency services, and more in the southeastern part of the city. [https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/gesellschaft/stromausfall-berlin-106.html (Tagesschau)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/suspected-arson-attack-berlin-leaves-50000-homes-without-power-2025-09-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sweden|Swedish]] [[Prime Minister of Sweden|prime minister]] [[Ulf Kristersson]] announces that [[Government of Sweden|the government]] will lower the [[age of criminal responsibility]] from 15 in response to rising cases of [[Crime in Sweden|criminal gangs]] recruiting children to commit serious crimes. [https://www.reuters.com/world/sweden-lower-age-criminal-responsibility-gangs-use-children-hitmen-2025-09-09/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Thailand|Thai]] [[Supreme Court of Thailand|Supreme Court]] rules that former [[Prime Minister of Thailand|prime minister]] [[Thaksin Shinawatra]] must serve a one-year prison term for [[Corruption in Thailand|corruption]], declaring his prior hospital detention unlawful. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cly7k2g37g4o (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Indian vice presidential election]]
**Elections take place for the next [[vice president of India]] following the early resignation of [[Jagdeep Dhankhar]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/vice-president-elections-voting-results-reactions-live-updates-september-9-2025/article70028318.ece (''The Hindu'')]
**[[C.P. Radhakrishnan]] is elected as the 15th vice president of [[India]]. [https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/vice-president-election-result-2025-live-updates-voting-polling-cp-radhakrishnan-b-sudershan-reddy-2784147-2025-09-09 (''India Today'')]
*[[2024–2025 French political crisis]]
**[[France|French]] [[Prime Minister of France|prime minister]] [[François Bayrou]] formally submits his resignation after losing a [[vote of confidence]] in the [[National Assembly]] the day before. [[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] appoints [[Sébastien Lecornu]] as the new prime minister. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/frances-macron-seeks-new-prime-minister-after-governments-collapse-2025-09-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Bougainvillean general election]]
**Off-island voting in the [[Autonomous Region of Bougainville]]'s general election concludes, with vote counting expected to begin on Thursday. [https://www.postcourier.com.pg/polling-completed-for-bougainville-election-counting-to-begin-thursday/ (''Papua New Guinea Post-Courier'')]

*[[Ethiopia]] fully launches the [[Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam]], [[Africa]]'s largest [[hydroelectric dam]], sparking concerns about [[Nile]] [[water security]] from [[Egypt]] and [[Sudan]]. [https://trt.global/afrika-english/article/bfbe80125cf5 (TRT)]
